vendre.metaTitle: Selling your property in Provence Verte — Alex Lopez iad
vendre.metaDescription: Free valuation, end-to-end support and tailored selling strategy for your property in Provence Verte and Haut-Var.
vendre.heroSubtitle: Free valuation based on real DVF sales, tailored property showcase and end-to-end support all the way to signing.
vendre.step1Desc: A precise price range based on recent DVF sales in your area — result in 3 minutes.
vendre.step2Desc: Professional photos, optimised listing and distribution on the major portals (SeLoger, Bien'ici, LeBonCoin, IAD).
vendre.step3Desc: Visits organised with qualified candidates, financing verified, detailed feedback after each visit.
vendre.step4Desc: I negotiate on your behalf and follow up with the notary all the way to the deed of sale.
vendre.expertisePara1: From valuation to signing, I support you with active listening and transparency. No inflated price to win the mandate — I give you the real market price.
vendre.expertisePara2: Based in Provence Verte and Haut-Var, I know every town, every street, every neighbourhood. That on-the-ground knowledge makes all the difference.
vendre.q1q: How much does a valuation cost?
vendre.q1a: The valuation is entirely free and without commitment. You get a precise price range in 3 minutes, based on recent DVF sales in your area.
vendre.q2q: What is the average time to sell a property in Provence Verte?
vendre.q2a: With a well-positioned price, most properties find a buyer in 4 to 12 weeks. An adapted distribution strategy often makes all the difference.
vendre.q3a: My fees are paid by the buyer in most cases. You benefit from full support with no hidden costs.
vendre.q4a: Preliminary agreement at the notary (~10 days after offer acceptance), then deed of sale 2 to 3 months later. I'm present at every step to answer your questions.
vendre.ctaDescription: A precise range in 3 minutes, based on real sales in your area.

acheter.metaTitle: Buying in Provence Verte — Alex Lopez iad
acheter.metaDescription: Personalised search, property selection and negotiation by your side to buy your home in Provence Verte and Haut-Var.
acheter.heroSubtitle: Describe your project, I select properties that match, I check the key points and I negotiate on your behalf.
acheter.step1Desc: Towns, property type, budget, key criteria — a few minutes to frame your search.
acheter.step2Desc: I send you only the properties that truly match, including ones not yet on the market (off-market).
acheter.step3Desc: Accompanied visits, DPE verification, diagnostics, urbanism compliance and analysis of recent sale prices in the area.
acheter.step4Desc: I negotiate on your behalf with DVF arguments, I help you draft the offer and follow up with the notary.
acheter.expertiseTitle: A well-supported buyer is a confident buyer
acheter.expertisePara1: Buying in Provence Verte requires a deep understanding of the local market. With detailed knowledge of every town and DVF prices, I help you avoid pitfalls and overpriced properties.
acheter.expertisePara2: My role: save you time, secure your purchase and negotiate the right price. No pressure and no fees for you (my fees are paid by the seller in most cases).
acheter.q1q: Are there any fees for the buyer?
acheter.q1a: My fees are paid by the seller in most cases. You benefit from my free support for your search, visits and negotiation.
acheter.q2q: How do you find off-market properties?
acheter.q2a: My local network — owners, former clients, other iad advisors — helps me uncover properties before they hit the market. You access exclusive opportunities.
acheter.q3q: Do you check the property before signing?
acheter.q3a: Yes, I check the DPE, diagnostics, urbanism compliance and the property's history. I can also direct you to an express property audit if needed.
acheter.q4a: I rely on recent DVF sales in the area to propose a fair price. I negotiate on your behalf and keep you informed at every step.
acheter.ctaDescription: A few minutes to frame your search — I get back to you with a tailored selection.

audit.metaTitle: Express property audit — Alex Lopez iad
audit.metaDescription: Free property audit in a few minutes: areas to watch, recommendations and detailed score in Provence Verte and Haut-Var.
audit.heroSubtitle: Before selling or buying, identify the areas to watch — legal, technical, energy — to decide with full awareness.
audit.step1Desc: A few basic details about the property — address, type, surface area.
audit.step2Desc: Roof, façade, joinery, plumbing, electrics, insulation, heating, DPE — overview of the key points.
audit.step3Desc: A score out of 100 and a per-category breakdown to identify strengths and areas to watch.
audit.step4Desc: Personalised advice and indicative cost of any work needed before buying or selling.
audit.expertisePara1: Before buying, the audit helps you check whether the asking price is consistent with the actual condition. Before selling, it helps you identify improvements that will enhance your property.
audit.expertisePara2: The audit is free, takes a few minutes and gives you a clear vision — no commitment, no pressure.
audit.q1a: Yes, entirely free and without commitment. You get your score and recommendations in just a few minutes.
audit.q2q: What does the audit PDF contain?
audit.q2a: Score out of 100, per-category breakdown, identified areas to watch, personalised recommendations and indicative estimate of any work needed.
audit.q3q: Does the audit replace a professional diagnostic?
audit.q3a: No, the audit gives a quick first overview. For a legal diagnostic (DPE, asbestos, lead, electrics…), you must call on a certified diagnostician.
audit.q4q: Does the audit work for a property I want to buy?
audit.q4a: Yes, that's even a typical case: use the listing's information to get a view before the visit or before making an offer.
audit.ctaDescription: Detailed score and personalised recommendations in just a few minutes.

faq.q1q: What is the difference between an iad advisor and a real estate agency?
faq.q1a: An independent iad advisor is a professional attached to SAS I@D France. They offer the same services as an agency (valuation, sale, purchase) with often lower fees thanks to reduced overhead.
faq.q2q: How much does a property valuation cost in Provence Verte and Haut-Var?
faq.q2a: The valuation is entirely free and without commitment. It is based on real recent sale prices in your area and on-the-ground knowledge of Provence Verte and Haut-Var.
faq.q3q: Which towns do you cover in Provence Verte and Haut-Var?
faq.q3a: I cover the entire Provence Verte and Haut-Var region: Barjols, Montmeyan, Quinson, Fox-Amphoux, Tavernes, Rians, Aups, Salernes, Ginasservis, Varages, Esparron-de-Verdon, Artignosc-sur-Verdon and all neighboring towns.
faq.q4q: How long does it take to sell a property in Provence Verte?
faq.q4a: The average selling time depends on the property and its price positioning. With a fair valuation and an adapted distribution strategy, most properties in Provence Verte and Haut-Var find a buyer in 4 to 12 weeks.
faq.q5q: What is the express property audit?
faq.q5a: It's a free review of your property done in a few minutes. It identifies areas to watch — legal, technical, environmental — so you can sell or buy with full awareness.
